scope: Two bounded Kitty animation frame-composition cases in a persistent tab (a=c: replace and blend onto frames, and refused compositions that change nothing); whole-frame compositions only, so every observation is one uniform color. The composed pixels are read from retained sources by the App's pane model; independently captured raw replies, paired original offscreen PNGs, complete cells/modes and wall-clock capture spans. Elapsed-time claims are bounded to this App build and run: no display-refresh cadence, other platform, frame-rate, snapshot/persistent-session or stock-grade claim.
